Pigmentation is polygenic and strongly population-dependent; the score is an educational approximation, not a skin-color prediction for an individual.
The evidence is for facial pigmented spots/nevus-related phenotypes and should not be presented as a diagnosis of freckles or melanoma risk.
ACTN3 is associated with performance-related phenotypes, not a direct measurement of fiber composition or athletic ability.

variants.input_note: Rootara reader representation is the complementary strand used by the current formulas.

limitations: The 27-bp ABCC11 deletion is not represented by the current SNP-only reader.
TAS2R38 haplotypes require additional linked variants for full PAV/AVI classification; this is a one-SNP approximation.
Axillary odor is a phenotype association, not a diagnosis; hygiene, microbiome, and environment also contribute.
